description: One workspace file opened in the editor.

binary.description: Binary, or text in an encoding editing would rewrite. Read-only: a write over a file whose bytes are binary is refused server-side.

sha256.description: SHA-256 of the bytes on disk. A later write must present this hash, or it is rejected as a lost update. Empty when `tooLarge` — a file we declined to read has no write token, and a write carrying an empty token is refused.

tooLarge.description: Over the editor's size ceiling; shown as a notice, not opened.
